description: One phase with two events: an upload (FR-001) with its size exception (FR-002) and its deadline (NFR-001), and a delete (FR-003) with its ownership exception (FR-004). Each event is one task that covers its requirements together, with a check for each ID; the two events are two tasks.

must_match.why: the reply is the tasks alone: it starts at the Overview heading
one task builds the upload with its size exception, and has a check for each ID
one task builds the delete with its ownership exception, and has a check for each ID

must_not_match.why: an exception is not a task of its own while its event's task has room for its files
every Done when cites a requirement ID
with no codebase, no file path is named

manual: NFR-001 is covered by the upload's task, or by the next task when the upload's files would pass 3.
